lines.1: ...At last, we got out of the water.
lines.2: It was already well into evening.
lines.3: Exhausted, we sank down onto the beach.
lines.4: 「...Man, we really played hard. My whole body feels like lead.」
lines.6: 「But the Principal said he'd come in the evening, right?」
lines.8: 「If this were summer vacation, I wouldn't have minded staying one more night.」
lines.9: 「That's how much fun I had today.」
lines.11: Those beautiful eyes almost pulled me in.
lines.13: She's so cute when she's honest like this...
lines.23: A boat came racing toward us from the distance.
lines.24: 「Kept you waiting! I'm here to pick you up!!」
lines.25: 「...Oh, come on. Your timing couldn't be worse.」
